slots.notes: Single looping product/atmosphere film that fills the right half of the section. The exact same source is rendered twice via two absolute inset-0 object-cover <video autoPlay muted loop playsInline> elements: a desktop panel (hidden below md, fills the right grid column to min-h-screen) and a mobile strip (md:hidden, fixed height:75vw below the product panel). object-cover crops the footage into both a tall half-screen portrait box and a wide 75vw landscape strip, so the asset has no fixed authoring aspect and must read well center-cropped in both orientations. A #111 background shows behind it while it loads. Native source is a CloudFront placeholder mp4.

Hero product bottle shot inside the left sky-blue panel. Rendered object-cover into a fixed portrait box (aspectRatio 220/340 ~ 11:17, width clamp(140px,40%,220px), borderRadius 2px) over a #D9D9D9 placeholder fill that shows while it loads. Cover-cropped and opaque (the box is filled), so transparency is not required; supply a full-bleed packshot framed for an upright ~11:17 crop.

mechanic: A two-up layout (md grid 1fr/1fr min-h-screen, stacked flex-col on mobile) pairing a static sky-blue product panel against a fullscreen object-cover looping product video, where an IntersectionObserver one-shot (threshold 0.15) flips a persistent visible flag that fires a staggered fade+slide-up entrance (opacity 0 + translateY -> 0, cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)) cascading through the panel's labels, bottle, caption, notes, and SHOP NOW button (delays 0/300/600/900/1150ms).
techDelivery: Standalone React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3 (default config/breakpoints) + Vite component spec, no extra packages. Entrance motion is a hand-rolled anim(visible, delay, {y,x,duration}) helper that returns a spread-able { style } object of inline opacity/transform CSS transitions (no motion library); reveal is gated by a native IntersectionObserver in a useEffect.
reskinNotes: All copy and both asset URLs are hardcoded in the component (SCENT_PRODUCT object + verbatim CloudFront video URL): product name 'Eau So Sweet', size '100 ml / 3.3 oz', the three note label/ingredient pairs, the top eyebrow labels (Daisy love/Sweet, or Daisy wild/Playful when the unused noteStyle='bold' variant is selected), and the 'SHOP NOW' button text. Colors are literal hex baked into inline styles and constants, not tokens: #4BB3ED panel bg, #000000 for every text run and the 1px button border, #D9D9D9 image placeholder, #111 video-load backdrop, and the #ffffff button hover fill that scales in from origin-left (with group-hover:text-black keeping the label legible over white). The note ingredients render uppercase tracking-widest as authored, and the bottle box is a fixed 220/340 aspect with width clamp(140px,40%,220px), so a differently-proportioned packshot will be cover-cropped. No fonts are declared — the section intentionally uses Tailwind's default system sans stack, so there is no swappable typeface.
